work.title: Ariettes oubliées
work.movement: II. Il pleure dans mon cœur

version.note: The performing forces are established. The precise edition, any session-specific alteration and the original sounding pitch are not established. The two-record Garden1904 set is an archival grouping, not a claim that these extracts form a two-movement composition.

performers.note: Both performers are named by the archive, national-library catalogue and specialist discography; no unnamed collaborator is supplied.

date.note: Only the year is established here; no exact day is inferred from a later reissue or modern repository date.

place.note: The city is documented. The studio, street address and recording engineer are not established.

label.note: Original commercial acoustic disc attribution. The1937IRCC/RCA carrier catalogued by BnF is a later reissue.

catalogue.note: OriginalG&T catalogue number. The archive describes a ten-inch disc.

matrixTakeSides.note: Internet Archive’s3047II disagrees with the3074 numbering in the discography and Phonobase. This appears consistent with a transposition error in the archive field, but it is not silently corrected. Suffix forms and the actual source disc’s take remain unresolved.

credits.note: The archive names an uploader account but does not identify a transfer engineer. Uploader identity is not converted into a recording or mastering credit.

date.note: The2019 added/public dates belong to the repository. No date of digitisation of this copy is established.

processing.value: Playback at74rpm; stylus-size field “25”; MP3 access file.
processing.note: The source supplies no units for the stylus-size string. Equalisation, noise reduction, pitch correction and equipment are not established. The speed is not treated as proof of the original session’s tuning or tempo.

digital.format: MP3 transfer of a ten-inch acoustic disc

composition.value: Underlying composition and original French words are out of copyright under ordinary life-plus-70 terms; the historical score predates1926.
composition.note: Debussy died1918 and Verlaine1896. No modern translation is reproduced; national exceptions and modern editions require separate consideration.

recording.value: Rule 2 — US public domain: original G&T commercial issue dated1904, before the1925 cutoff.
recording.note: The originalG&T catalogue and1904 attribution establish a pre-cutoff recording publication basis. The1937 reissue and2019 archive upload are not used as the original publication date. No free-recording licence is inferred from a composition-only tag.

rights.creditLine: Claude Debussy, Il pleure dans mon cœur; Mary Garden, soprano, and Claude Debussy, piano. Paris,1904; G&T33449; Internet Archive transfer. US pre-1926 publication basis.
